title: Apply for a Standard Visitor visa - GOV.UK

visa_eligibility.serbian_citizens: Serbian citizens require a visa to enter or transit the UK. They must apply for a Standard Visitor visa before travelling. The visa allows stays of up to 6 months. Applicants must demonstrate intention to leave after the visit, sufficient funds, and a genuine reason for visiting.
visa_eligibility.other_nationals: Other nationals residing in Serbia with valid residence permits may also apply. Requirements depend on the applicant's nationality. EU/EEA/Swiss citizens have a different process and may be able to enter without a visa.

processing_times.notes: Most decisions are made within 3 weeks (21 calendar days) after submitting biometrics. Priority processing (5 working days) is available for non-settlement visas as a paid optional service at the VFS Global application centre. Applications can be submitted up to 3 months before travel.

application_location.center: VFS Global UK Visa Application Centre Belgrade
application_location.booking: Online booking via https://visa.vfsglobal.com/srb/en/gbr — applicants must submit the online application first, then book an in-person appointment at the centre to submit biometrics and documents.

visa_fees.service_fee: VFS Global service fee applies on top of the visa fee; exact amount displayed at booking. Optional premium services available: priority processing (5 working days), premium lounge access, courier passport return.
fee_exemptions: Children under 6 years may be exempt — verify at time of application
Some diplomatic passport holders may be exempt

required_documents_all_applicants: Valid passport or travel document (valid for the entire stay)
Biometric enrolment at VFS Global application centre
Proof of genuine visitor status (letter explaining purpose of visit)
Proof of intention to leave the UK after the visit
Bank statements or financial documents showing sufficient funds to cover the trip
Accommodation details (hotel bookings or host letter)
Evidence of ties to Serbia (property, employment, family) to show intent to return
Non-English documents must include certified English translation with: translator confirmation of accuracy, translation date, translator's full name, signature and contact details
additional_documents_by_nationality: Non-Serbian residents in Serbia: valid residence permit or long-stay visa for Serbia
Applicants with previous refusals: explanation letter and updated supporting documents

required: Birth certificate or adoption papers proving legal relationship to parent/guardian
Photocopy of parent/guardian's passport (photo page including signature and passport number)
If travelling without parents: signed parental consent letter confirming travel arrangements, caregiver details, and travel method
Evidence of relationship if child has a different family name from parent/guardian
documents_for_minors.note: Children under 18 travelling alone or with only one parent/guardian require additional consent documentation.

tourism: Proof of employment or ties to Serbia ensuring return
business: Invitation letter from UK company or event organiser on company letterhead
Details of business activities (meetings, conferences, interviews)
Letter from Serbian employer confirming leave of absence and that work will not be performed in the UK
family_or_private_visit: Invitation letter from the UK resident/citizen being visited
Proof of relationship (e.g. birth certificate, marriage certificate)
Evidence that the UK host can financially support the visit if sponsoring
medical_treatment: Letter from doctor or consultant in UK detailing: medical condition, estimated costs, treatment duration, and treatment location
Evidence of ability to fund treatment and living costs
Letter from Serbian doctor confirming diagnosis and reason for seeking treatment in UK
transit: Proof of onward travel departing within 48 hours
Valid visa or entry documentation for destination country
Proof of funds for onward journey

employees: Letter from employer on company headed paper detailing: role/job title, salary, length of employment
Confirmation of approved leave of absence
entrepreneurs: Accountant letter or tax returns confirming income
students: Confirmation of leave of absence from institution
Proof of funding (scholarship, parental support, savings)
For medical electives: written confirmation from UK Higher Education provider
retirees: Proof of pension (pension statements, bank statements showing regular pension payments)
Evidence of sufficient funds for the trip
Evidence of ties to Serbia (property ownership, family)

special_provisions: UK visas are now digital (eVisa) rather than physical stickers in passports for most applicants. Applicants should verify they have a UKVI account to access their eVisa after approval. Long-term visitor visas (2, 5, or 10 years) are available at higher fees and allow multiple entries with stays of up to 6 months per visit. The 'Keep My Passport' service is available at VFS Global but cannot be combined with priority processing.
